title: Magic Chef — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Magic Chef.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Budget Basics." Value tier. Magic Chef makes basic small and compact appliances — mini-fridges, countertop microwaves, wine coolers, and portable appliances at entry-level pricing. Owned by Midea.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Ultra-budget compact needs. Dorms, break rooms.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Magic Chef:

• Entry-level compact appliances

• Midea manufacturing backing

• Available everywhere

• Budget wine coolers and mini-fridges

• Simple, affordable basics
